page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin notes on the right, beside the paragraph with the numbered positions (1. and 2.). Small reference marks in the left margin. Catchword "non" at the foot, right.

main_text.l: vam, & falsum dixisset Christus. Resp. In e-
jusmodi propositionibus semper subintelligitur
physica Dei motio: alioqui si ad literam prae-
merentur, sequeretur nudam cognitionem
objecti sufficere ad actum credendi absque in-
fusione novae potentiae, quod nemo diceret.
Similiter illud, si Tyrij vidissent signa, resi-
puissent: non sequitur visionem miraculorum
indeclinabiliter determinare voluntatem ad
resipiscentiam. Consequens enim est aperte
falsum, ideoque semper ad resipiscentiam re-
quiritur tacita conditio,non expressa, sed sub-
intellecta, ex praevia motione efficacis gra-
tiae: alioqui poterant Tyrij vidisse signa & qui-
dem plura quam viderunt Capernaum & Beth-
saida, nunquam tamen resipuisse. Sed non sta-
tui hic funem contentionis trahere, utraque o-
pinio sua probabilitate non caret.
5. De determinatione itaque secundae clas-
sis, nempe aequivoca, tota instituitur dispu-
tatio tum in actibus naturae, tum gratiae,
& de utrisque brevitatis studio simul disce-
ptabo.
Adversarii varias hic determinationes nobis
dant, illiberali tamen munificentia. 1. Fonseca
ait Deum movere voluntatem efficientia mot-
iva per modum affectus, suadendo (quod
nec negavit Pelagius) non efficientia Physica,
quae sit determinativa absoluti consensus. 2.
Distinct. ib. vult actionem Dei in voluntatem
esse motivam, per modum naturae, quatenus
author naturae tribuit ei vim sele determinandi,

marginalia.note: Fonsec. metaph. lib. 6. c. 2. q. 4. sect. 13.

page.notes: Printed page 369; running head "à DEO DETERMINATI." The first word "vam," starts at the scan edge, so the previous page's line is cut off; it is kept as a fragment. The right margin note is partly cut; "Fonsec." and the reference are read from fragments, so the abbreviation is doubtful. Small marks in the left margin (a "1" beside "Similiter", a mark beside "tui hic", and small dots) look like reference marks or edge artefacts and have no printed text, so they are not transcribed. The catchword "non" is set at the right below the last line.
